person.bio: I study how people and AI systems keep shared documents trustworthy over time. My lab builds provenance-aware writing tools and evaluates them with newsrooms, libraries and civic groups.

news.text: Our lab received an NSF CAREER award to study provenance in collaborative writing.

publications.title: Edit Trails: Making AI Suggestions Accountable in Shared Documents
publications.authors: P. Raman, J. Ortiz, M. Chen

publications.title: Ledger Notes: Lightweight Provenance for Newsroom Fact-Checking
